name: deeporigin-url-shortener
description: Root convenience scripts for running the backend and frontend together.
//: This root manifest exists ONLY to run both apps with a single command.
It deliberately does NOT declare npm workspaces. Workspaces would hoist
node_modules and move the lockfiles to the root, which would break both
Dockerfiles — each copies its own package.json + package-lock.json and runs
`npm ci` inside its own build context. Keeping the two apps independently
installable is what lets them build and deploy separately.

scripts.//dev: Starts Postgres, applies migrations, then runs both dev servers side by side. Ctrl+C stops both.
scripts.predev: npm run db:up && npm run db:migrate
scripts.dev: concurrently --names "api,web" --prefix-colors "blue.bold,magenta.bold" --kill-others-on-fail "npm --prefix backend run start:dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.//setup: One-time install of dependencies for both apps.
scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.//db: Postgres runs in Docker even in local dev — no host install needed.
scripts.//docker: Containerised stacks. Overlays are opt-in; --remove-orphans is baked in because switching modes otherwise leaves the previous mode's containers holding ports.
scripts.docker:full: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.scale.yml -f docker-compose.observability.yml up -d --build --remove-orphans --wait
scripts.docker:down: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.scale.yml -f docker-compose.observability.yml down --remove-orphans
scripts.docker:reset: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.scale.yml -f docker-compose.observability.yml down --remove-orphans -v
scripts.docker:ps: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.scale.yml -f docker-compose.observability.yml ps
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
